//: Used in: components/billing/TransactionPreview (transactionPreview namespace). One row in the advertiser money history. A failed PAYG charge has its own explainer (explainPaygFailed) — the SYSTEM retries it, the user's fix is updating the card; only a failed prepaid purchase invites the user to try again.
explainPurchase: You added prepaid credits to your budget.
explainPaygCharge: Your card was charged for a share that your credits didn't cover.
explainPending: The payment is being confirmed. Your credits appear as soon as it goes through.
explainFailed: The payment didn't go through and nothing was added. Feel free to try again.
explainPaygFailed: The charge for a share didn't go through. We'll retry it automatically — if it keeps failing, update your card in the wallet.
explainCanceled: The payment was canceled before completing and nothing was charged.
explainRefunded: This purchase was refunded back to your card.
explainSpend: The reward for this share was paid from your budget.
explainRefund: A credit purchase was refunded from your budget back to your card.
explainPromo: Tagly added promotional credits to your budget.
explainReferral: You earned a bonus from an account you referred.
